identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.07c][117.c] Prove Observatory security, privacy, and adversarial behavior

values.task_boundary: Bootstrap, design-review, bind, implement, prove, review, publish, CI, and finish only #281 Observatory security/privacy/adversarial proof for the integrated candidate; do not absorb #279/#280/#282 or parent coordination scope.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Browser-visible transcript, roster, room, history, and operator-attention content rejects XSS and unsafe HTML/script/event-handler rendering under adversarial fixture input.
AC-2: Credential and token handling proof shows browser fixtures do not contain agent private signing material, provider secrets, raw token values, or secret-bearing durable evidence.

AC-3: Origin/transport proof records the allowed local/public-safe origin assumptions and fail-closed behavior for mismatched, missing, or downgraded transport/origin metadata without claiming cloud deployment.
AC-4: Replay, confused-deputy, stale-data, denial, and refusal states remain explicit and cannot be masked into successful delivery, authority, or acknowledgement by browser-side behavior.
AC-5: Redaction proof shows private cognition, raw provider payloads, secrets, and sensitive identifiers are excluded or visibly redacted in Observatory-facing evidence and durable #281 artifacts.
AC-6: Proof artifacts are deterministic, credential-free, public-safe, and tied to one exact integrated candidate revision.

AC-7: Any source changes are Observatory security/privacy presentation or test-only and do not alter Runtime authority, acknowledgement, room routing, durable history, receipt, accessibility, performance/recovery, or final qualification semantics.
AC-8: Fresh exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings, required CI is green on the published head, and typed finish derives terminal authority before #282 consumes #281.
non_goals: Runtime authority, signing, acknowledgement protocol, room routing, durable history, receipt, retention, or policy changes
Final production qualification assembly owned by #282
Cloud/public deployment, Unity feature implementation, provider credentials, raw provider payload inspection, or paid/optional jobs
